title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 9: Adonai Mitchell returns to lineups

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 9: Adonai Mitchell returns to lineups
sources.description: After disappearing in Week 7, Adonai Mitchell rebounded with a WR1 performance in Week 8. He is one of the best waiver wire adds this week, along with Tyler Allgeier and Seth McGowan.
